profile.headline: Site Reliability Engineer
profile.summary: An individual that hates doing boring things, and likes writing code to do them for him! Ask me about anything cloud native, especially around Kubernetes.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, and deployed the production Kubernetes infrastructure used to deliver all applications to customers, as well as the supporting infrastructure including Prometheus, Grafana and Elasticsearch.
Manage the multiple content distribution networks utilized to deliver our applications in the most efficient way possible.
Build and enhance CI/CD pipeline functionality using Jenkins, FluxCD and other related tooling to help deliver the quickest software turn around possible.
Designed and maintain disaster recovery sites in public clouds, reliably demonstrating the ability to restore 50+ microservices with an RTO under an hour.

positions.title: Linux Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for managing a large fleet of Linux servers using Chef and Terraform, hosted on-premises in VMWare and physical servers, as well as in GCP and AWS.

positions.title: Helpdesk Specialist
positions.description:
During my time on Rosetta Stone's help desk team, I handled a large number of technical issues ranging from virus removal to networking issues. I worked with several ticket systems including: Quickbase, Jira, Cherwell, and Remedyforce. 

While working on the help desk team, I took it upon myself to build out and implement a new asset management system based on open source software, CMDBuild and OCS Inventory, that would go on to replace software previously licensed from LANDesk.
I implemented a new-to-Rosetta Stone PC imaging solution using Microsoft's Deployment Toolkit and Windows Deployment Services that would go in to production use in our main and remote offices world-wide.
I built and maintained Mac OS X images using DeployStudio, as well as troubleshot various functionality issues that arose with this service.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description: Responsible for troubleshooting and repairing computer systems as well as delivering professional customer service in person and over the phone.
